notes:
Founders: small 3-person indie studio building a dev-focused chat/code helper embedded in their IDE plugin. No AE touch — pure PLG.
- Quote from lead dev: "Need something that is cheap to run in prod for early users + predictable latency; don't want to manage infra."
- Primary: chat assistant + semantic search (embeddings). Also exploring code-assistant snippets.
- Perf targets: median gen latency <200ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens), tail P95 <500ms desirable. Typical traffic: bursty, 3–8 QPS during dev demos; concurrency per user small.
- Cost sensitivity: very price conscious; aiming for <$0.01 per active session on average. Wants estimates: tokens per convo * cost model.
- Model prefs: open models acceptable; would like Redwood-curated smaller / quantized variants for cost. Streaming + function/tool-calling required for IDE integration.
- Ops: public cloud only for now; no VPC/on-prem. Basic audit logs useful for debugging but no enterprise SSO yet.
- UX: signed up via docs link, used SDK snippets, posted in Slack asking about best-batching strategy for interactive chat.
- Asked for a short sample billing projection and example request/response sizes for a 10k-user pilot.
- Founder is pragmatic: wants to keep everything on hosted API until product-market fit then revisit Dedicated.
use_case_summary: Indie dev studio building an IDE-embedded chat/code helper + search. Wants hosted API (self-serve) with streaming + embeddings. Low-latency target, strong cost sensitivity, prefers open/quantized models for cheaper unit cost.
onboarding_notes: Give in-app tips: recommended model variants for cost/latency, batching examples, prefix caching suggestions. Provide short cost calculator template and sample SDK snippet for streaming in-browser. Point to embeddings best-practices doc.
pitch_observations: Good trial activity but shallow — main ask is cost predictability. No security/compliance blockers. High conversion chance if we present a clear cost / latency tradeoff sheet for their exact convo length assumptions.
